ruleDefinitions.name: Successful Authentications From Countries You Do Not Operate Out Of
ruleDefinitions.description: Detect successful authentications from countries you do not operate out of. Note: Unmapped fields: Status, Location

sequences.query: Status = "Success" AND  NOT (Location = RGX(".*\\<Countries\\ you\\ DO\\ operate\\ out\\ of\\ e\\,g\\ GB\\,\\ use\\ OR\\ for\\ multiple\\>.*"))
